title: SAT Circles: Equations, Arcs, and Radians
description:
Circle questions on the SAT follow a handful of patterns. This lesson covers the one fact you need for each, then works through 7 SAT-style practice questions that get harder as they go.

You'll learn:
• The circle equation: center, radius, and the sign flip
• Completing the square when the equation is expanded
• Arc length and sector area as a fraction of the circle
• Converting between degrees and radians (and when s = rθ works)
• Central vs. inscribed angles, and why a tangent is perpendicular to the radius
• A test-day checklist for any circle question

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Geometry and Trigonometry → Circles).
